summary: If you are locked out after disabling the local authenticator, find its ID with aap-gateway-api authenticators --list and re-enable it with aap-gateway-manage authenticators --enable <id>.
questions: How do I re-enable the local authenticator from the command line?
Locked out of AAP after disabling local authentication

answer_card.title: Re-enable the local authenticator
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
aap-gateway-api authenticators --list        # find the local authenticator ID
aap-gateway-manage authenticators --enable <id>
```
